cards.text: The LORD is speaking through Isaiah the prophet, and He calls out to everyone who pursues righteousness and seeks Him. First He says listen, and then He says LOOK. Look back at where you came from.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people to look back at where they came from. What picture does He use for it?

answers.text: The rock they were cut from
The clay they were shaped from

cards.text: Then He gives them two people to look to: their father, and the mother who gave them birth.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people to look to ___ their father, and to Sarah who gave them birth.

cards.text: That's Abraham and his wife Sarah. When the LORD called Abraham, he was but one: party of ONE, table for ONE, friend.

cards.question: Abraham was just one man when the LORD called him. What did the LORD do with him?

answers.text: Made him king over the nations

cards.text: Next comes a promise for Zion, the city of Jerusalem. The LORD will comfort Zion and look with compassion on all her ruins.

cards.question: The LORD will make Zion's desert like the garden of the LORD. What will He make her wilderness like?
Once the LORD comforts Zion, the sound of mourning will fill her streets.

cards.text: Then He calls out again: pay attention, My people, and listen, My nation. Something will go out from Him.

cards.question: The LORD says a ___ will go out from Him, and His justice will become a light to the nations.
After promising His law and His justice for the nations, the LORD says He will bring it about quickly.

cards.text: His righteousness draws near, His salvation is on the way, and His arms will bring justice to the nations. Then He talks about the islands.

cards.question: The LORD's salvation is on the way. What does He say the islands will do?

answers.text: Look for Him and wait in hope
Hide from Him and turn away
Forget Him and go their way

cards.text: Now look up at the heavens and down at the earth: the heavens will vanish like smoke, and the earth will wear out like a garment. Friend, I know wearing out: after years of stamping cookies in the Millers' kitchen, my edges went so soft my cookies came out looking like CLOUDS.

cards.question: The heavens will vanish and the earth will wear out, but the LORD's ___ will last forever.

cards.text: Then He speaks to people with His law in their hearts: don't fear the scorn of men, and don't be broken by their insults. Folks can laugh at a mustache this big all they want, friend, and I'm STILL standing: on a gold base, but STANDING.

cards.question: The LORD tells His people not to fear the ones who insult them. What does He say will happen to those insulters?

answers.text: Moths will eat them like a garment
Their own insults will fall on them
They will be scattered like dust

cards.text: Then comes a cry: "Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD." It asks that arm to wake up as in days past, and starts remembering what it has done.
It asks: wasn't it You who cut Rahab (not the Rahab of Jericho) to pieces and pierced through the dragon?

cards.question: The speaker remembers the LORD drying up the sea, the waters of the great deep. What did He make in the depths of that sea?

answers.text: A road for the redeemed to cross over
A home for the creatures of the deep
A wall to hold back the enemy

cards.text: And here's where it's all headed: the redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing.

cards.question: The redeemed come into Zion singing. What are they crowned with?
When the redeemed enter Zion, sorrow and sighing will follow close behind them.

cards.text: Sorrow and sighing take off RUNNING, and I spent years in the back of a junk drawer as a professional sigher. Then the LORD speaks: "I, even I, am He who comforts you."

cards.question: The LORD asks why His people should be afraid of mortal man, a son of man who withers like ___.

cards.text: But the LORD says they've forgotten Him, their Maker, the One who stretched out the heavens and laid the foundations of the earth.

cards.question: The LORD's people have forgotten their Maker. How does the LORD say they live?

cards.text: Then the LORD asks about the oppressor they're so scared of: "But where is the fury of the oppressor?"

cards.question: The LORD says the captive will soon be ___ and will not die in the dungeon.
The LORD says the freed captive's bread will not be lacking.

cards.text: Then the LORD says who He is: the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar. The LORD of Hosts is His name.
He says, "I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand…" And it all builds to one thing He says to Zion.

cards.question: After all the comfort and all the promises, what does the LORD say to Zion?
